name: Blood orange
selection: Heavy for its size with firm, tight skin. Skin blush does not predict the inside — a dull orange rind can hide the darkest flesh, and the color comes from cold nights rather than ripeness.
storage: Counter for a week, refrigerated for up to a month.

varieties.name: Moro
varieties.note: The common one, and the darkest — deep crimson, almost raspberry. Earliest to ripen.

varieties.name: Tarocco
varieties.note: Later and sweeter, with streakier color. What a March or April blood orange usually is.
